title: Held Always
story:
A man was cleaning his old house one day.

He found a small box of memories.

Inside, there were photos from his childhood.

In one picture, he was a baby in his mother’s arms.

In another, he was learning to walk, holding his father’s hand.

There were school photos.

Moments of laughter.

Moments of struggle.

Then he saw a recent photo.

His parents were now old.

Their hair had turned gray.

Their steps were slow.

As he looked through the pictures, he realized something.

All his life, someone had been caring for him.

Holding him.

Guiding him.

Even when he did not notice.

And now, as time had passed, that care had not ended.

It had only taken a different form.

In life, seasons change.

We grow.

We age.

People around us change.

But God’s care never changes.

From the beginning to the end,

He carries us.

He sustains us.

He never lets us go.
life_lesson:
God’s care for you does not fade with time.

From your beginning to your old age, He carries and sustains you.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for caring for me throughout my life.

From my first breath until now, You have never left me.

Help me to trust that You will continue to sustain me.

In every season of life.

Hold me when I am weak.

Guide me when I am unsure.

And remind me that I am always in Your hands.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Can you see God's care in different seasons of your life?

Do you trust Him to carry you into the future?

How can you rest in His care today?
verse:
Even to your old age and gray hairs I am He.
I am He who will sustain you.
I have made you and I will carry you.
I will sustain you and I will rescue you.
